translations.text: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice before him with trembling.
Many said of me, “There is no salvation for him with his God.”
Children of humanity, how long will you be hard-hearted? Why do you love vanity and seek falsehood?
I plead with you, Lord. In the morning you will hear my voice; in the morning I will prepare to appear before you.
Let no lawless people dwell before your eyes. You have hated those who practice lawlessness.
Depart from me, all you who practice lawlessness. The Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
But if he does not turn back to him, he has sharpened his sword and drawn his bow.
Look, he labored to bring forth lawlessness; he conceived pain and gave birth to injustice.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will recount all your wonders.
You see him; you look upon suffering and anger, to take him into your hands. The poor man has entrusted himself to you, and you are the orphan’s helper.
To give justice to the orphan and the destitute, so that a human being may no longer continue his boasting upon the face of the earth.
I have trusted in the Lord. How can you say to me, “Flee to the mountains like a sparrow”?
He will rain snares upon sinners; fire and sulfur and a stormy wind will be the portion of their cup.
May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips and boastful tongues.
I always saw the Lord before me, for he is at my right hand so that I will not be shaken.
Hear righteousness, Lord, and attend to my requests. Give ear to my prayers, for they do not come from deceitful lips.
You have made your mercies wonderful, you who save those who trust in you from those who oppose your right hand.
I will press them, and they will no longer be able to stand; they will fall beneath my feet.
You made my enemies flee and destroyed those who hate me.
Therefore I will give thanks to you among the nations and sing psalms to your name.
He set his tent in the sun, and he is like a bridegroom coming out of his bridal chamber. He rejoices like a giant to run his course.
They stumbled and fell, but we rose and stood upright.
Lord, save the king, and hear us on the day when we call to you.
You dwell in the holy places, you who are praised by Israel.
Our fathers trusted in you; they trusted in you, and you delivered them.
You are the one who brought me out of the womb, my hope from my mother's breasts.
The poor will eat and be satisfied. Those who seek the Lord will praise him. Their hearts will live forever and ever.
The one whose hands are clean and whose heart is blameless, who has not given himself over to vanity and has not sworn deceitfully to his neighbor.
My eyes are always turned toward the Lord, and he brings my feet out of the snare.
Test me, Lord, and examine me; test my kidneys and my heart.
Wait for the Lord and take courage. Let your heart grow strong, and wait for the Lord.
Give them, Lord, according to their deeds and according to the lawlessness of their ways. Repay them according to the works of their hands; give them their own recompense.
Save your people and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and lift them up forever.
The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars, and the Lord shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
He will crush them like the young sapling of Lebanon, which is beloved like the offspring of a unicorn.
Lord, by your favor you gave strength to my beauty. You turned your face away from me, and I became troubled.
Day and night your hand lay heavy upon me. I fell into misery, because thorns pierced me. Rest.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon all the children of humankind.
To deliver their lives from death and feed them in famine.
Lord, when will you look? Rescue my life from their cunning, and my one and only life from the lions.
Your righteousness is like mountains, O God; your judgments are like great depths. You preserve humans and animals, Lord.
From you, Lord, comes the fountain of life, and by the light of your face we see light.
There all who practice lawlessness will fall. They will be cast out and will no longer be able to stand.
Trust in the Lord and do good. Dwell in the land, and you will be nourished by its abundance.
Delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
I saw the wicked man exalted and towering like the cedars of Lebanon.
The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord. He watches over them in times of distress.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your indignation or discipline me in your anger.
I suffered and was brought very low; I went about mourning continually.
But I am like a deaf man who does not hear, like a mute man who does not open his mouth.
Remove my afflictions from me, for I have wasted away under the power of your hand.
You have done many wonders, O Lord my God, and in your plans no one is like you. I recounted them and spoke of them, and they were more than could be counted.
Let those who said to me, “Aha, aha!” immediately and swiftly bear shame.
The Lord rescues him and keeps him alive, makes him blessed on the earth, and does not deliver him into the hands of his enemies.
Judge me, O God, and vindicate me in my case against a nation that is not holy; rescue me from a sinful, deceitful man.
All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face.
For your sake we are put to death all day long; we were counted as sheep for slaughter.
Listen, daughter, and see; incline your ear. Forget your people and your father’s house.
The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.
The Lord is exalted and fearsome, a great king over all the earth.
As we heard, so we have also seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God. God laid its foundations forever.
We have received your mercy, O God, in the midst of your people.
Let Mount Zion rejoice, and let the daughters of Judah exult because of your judgments, O Lord.
I myself know my lawless deeds, and my sins are before me at all times.
Against you alone I have sinned, O Lord, and have done evil before you, so that you may be justified in your words and victorious when you are judged.
My mother conceived in lawlessness and gave birth to me in sins.
Sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Turn your face away from my sins, and remove all my lawless deeds from me.
Rescue me from those who practice lawlessness; deliver me from bloodthirsty men.
They wanted to hunt down my life, and mighty men came upon me—not because of my sins or transgressions.
And a house of refuge on the day of my distress.
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my king; Moab is the basin of my hope.
Hear my prayers, O God, and attend to my prayers, O Lord.
You, O God, heard my prayers; you gave an inheritance to those who fear your name.
But submit to God alone, my soul, for my salvation comes from him.
Say to God, “How fearsome are your works! Because of your great power, your enemies have lied to you.”
I will offer you burnt offerings [?], with rams and incense, and I will offer you bulls and goats.
Come, listen to me, all you who fear God, and I will tell you what he has done for my soul.
Let the righteous rejoice and exult before him, and delight in their joy.
The mountain of God is a fertile mountain, a mountain of many peaks and a fertile mountain.
He ascended to the heights, took captives, took plunder, distributed gifts, and gave them to the children of men, so that even among unbelievers the Lord God might dwell. Blessed is he.
The princes went ahead to raise praise among the musicians and singers.
In the assemblies bless God, and bless the Lord, you who come from the springs of Israel.
Rebuke the beast of the reeds, the gatherings of bulls, and the herds of heifers. Let those chosen for silver be rejected. Scatter the nations that desire war.
Let messengers come from Egypt; let the Indians be the first to extend their hands to God.
I became a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother's sons.
For they persecuted the one you struck, and added to the wounds of my suffering.
Add sins to their sins, so that they may not enter into your righteousness.
I am poor and afflicted; let your salvation, O God, receive me.
My enemies spoke against me, and those who besieged my soul plotted together.
My God, do not keep far from me; O God, attend to helping me.
In his days let righteousness arise, and abundant peace, until the moon comes to an end.
But as for me, my feet had almost slipped, and my steps had nearly stumbled.
Therefore pride seized them; they clothed themselves in their impiety and injustice.
Look, those who have distanced themselves from you will perish; you will destroy all who rebelled against you.
We will give thanks to you, O God; we will give thanks and call upon your name. I will recount all your wonders.
When you appeared from heaven, your wrath became manifest; the earth feared and trembled.
O God, your ways are holy. What god is great like our God?
So that the children born in another generation may know, and may rise and tell these things to their own children.
The sons of Ephraim, drawing their bows fully and powerfully, turned their quivers back on the day of battle.
Therefore the Lord heard this and delayed; fire blazed in Jacob, and wrath rose against Israel.
For they did not believe in God and did not trust in his salvation.
He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of heaven.
He sent dogflies among them, and they devoured them; he ruined them with frogs.
Fire devoured their young men, and no one mourned for their virgins.
But he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.
Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name. Lord, save us and forgive our sins for your name’s sake.
Let the groaning of the prisoners come before you; according to the greatness of your arm, preserve the children of those who were slain.
For the end. Concerning those who rave. A testimony of Asaph. A psalm concerning the Ethiopians.
You transplanted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted them.
And care for what your right hand planted, and for the son of man whom you strengthened for yourself.
For the end. Concerning the winepresses. A psalm of Asaph, for the fifth day of the week.
You forgave the wrongdoing of your people; you covered all their sins.
You are great, Lord, and you do wonders; you alone are God.
Your mercy toward me was great; you rescued my soul from the depths of the underworld.
The glorified one spoke about you—behold, O city of God.
Lord, God of my salvation, I cried out by day and stood before you at night.
You put my friends and acquaintances far from me because of my misery.
I will establish his offspring forever and ever, and his throne like the days of heaven.
Whoever dwells in the help of the Most High will rest in heaven under the shelter of God.
From the thing that moves in darkness, from the demon’s stumbling block at midday.
Even in old age they will be abundant; they will be lush and tender with richness.
He established the world so that it would not be shaken. Your throne has been established from the beginning; you are forever.
In his hands are all the expanses of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.
A psalm of David, at the time when the temple was built.
Let the fields rejoice, and everything in them; then let all the trees of the forest rejoice.
The Lord builds Zion and will appear in it in his glory.
The children of your servants will dwell in it, and their offspring will prosper forever.
For he knew how we were formed and remembered that we are dust.
How great are your works, Lord! You made everything with wisdom, and the earth was filled with your creatures.
Remember the wonders he performed, his mighty deeds, and the judgments of his mouth.
The covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac.
It ate all the grass of their land and consumed all the fruit of their fields.
Egypt rejoiced at their departure, for the fear of the Lord had fallen upon them.
May we see the goodness of your chosen ones, rejoice in the joy of your nation, and glory in your inheritance.
He gave them what they requested and sent fullness into their souls.
He raised his hand against them to strike them in the wilderness.
Because they embittered his spirit, he murmured with his lips.
They sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons and shed innocent blood.
He delivered them into the hands of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
Many times he rescued them, but they embittered him with their schemes and were brought low by their lawlessness.
He remembered his covenant and relented according to his abundant mercy.
They wandered in the wilderness along a waterless road and found no city to dwell in.
Those who sat in darkness and in the shadow of death were bound in poverty as in iron chains.
For he shattered the bronze gates and broke the iron bars.
Those who went down to the sea in ships and carried on their work on the vast waters.
He blessed them, and they multiplied greatly, and their livestock did not decrease.
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my king.
Set a sinner over him; let Satan stand at his right hand.
Help me, Lord my God, and save me according to your mercy.
Let them know that this is your hand and that you, Lord, have done this.
Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, because of your mercy and your truth.
They have mouths but do not speak; they have eyes but do not see.
They have ears but do not hear; they have noses but do not smell.
I said in my astonishment, “Every person is a liar.”
I will offer you a sacrifice of praise and call upon the name of the Lord.
I will offer my prayers to the Lord before all his people.
I have kept your ordinances; do not abandon me completely.
With my whole heart I have sought you; do not cast me away from your commandments.
With my lips I will recount all the ordinances of your mouth.
For rulers sat and spoke evil of me, but your servant pondered your ordinances.
I have chosen the paths of your truth, and I have not forgotten your ordinances.
See, I have longed for your commandments; in your righteousness preserve my life.
You have dealt kindly with your servant, Lord, according to your word.
Let your mercy comfort me, according to your word to your servant.
Let my heart be blameless in your righteousness, so that I may not be put to shame.
They almost destroyed me on earth, but I did not abandon your commandments.
I became wiser than all my teachers, for your testimonies were my discourse.
I became wiser than the elders, for I examined your commandments.
I called to you with my whole heart; hear me, Lord, for I have sought your righteous decrees.
Plead my case and deliver me, and preserve my life according to your word.
Rulers persecuted me without cause, and my heart stood in fear of your words.
I hated and despised sins, and I loved your law.
My soul kept your testimonies and loved them greatly.
My lips will pour forth your praises when you teach me your righteous decrees.
How the Guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor goes to sleep!
If the Lord had not been with us when people rose up against us,
then the waters would indeed have engulfed us; our souls would have passed through torrents.
The one who trusts in the Lord is like Mount Zion. May the one who dwells in Jerusalem never be shaken.
When the Lord restored the captives of Zion, we were comforted.
Blessed are all who fear the Lord and walk in his ways.
Let them be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can be gathered in a handful.
Let us enter his dwelling places; let us bow down at the place where his feet have stood.
For the sake of David, your beloved, do not turn your face away from your anointed.
There I will cause a horn to spring up for David; I will prepare a lamp for my anointed.
Like dew that falls from Hermon upon Mount Zion, there the Lord prepared the blessing and eternal life.
Here, bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord who stand in the Lord’s house and in the courts of our God at night.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by human hands.
And he delivered us from the hands of our enemies, for his mercy endures forever.
Your friends have become greatly honored by me, O God, and their rulers have grown very powerful.
A psalm of David, at the time when his son Absalom pursued him.
In your mercy, destroy my enemies; bring to ruin all who oppress my soul, for I am your servant.
Flash your lightning and throw them into confusion; send out your arrows and scatter them.
Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever and for ever and ever.
He who gives the animals their food, and the young ravens that cry to him.
Praise the Lord from the earth, you dragons and all the depths.
Let them bless his name with praise and psalms, and sing him a psalm of praise.
Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in the firmament of his power.
Praise him with sweet words; praise him with an audible voice; praise him with the sound of thanksgiving.
My hands made a psaltery, and my fingers fashioned an instrument of praise.
I went out to meet the Philistine and cursed his idols.
